scientific_integrity: Exact finite exhaustive proofs from complete bitmask enumeration and an independent maximal-clique/isometry orbit reconstruction; no infinite extension, no human or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The assertion is finite: it covers the sixteen-vertex cube and an exhaustive comparison with cubes of dimensions one to three, not an all-dimensional formula. Maximal-independent-set cardinality counts were already published. Exhaustive verification and a review against indexed literature are not independent mathematical certification; the complete unavailable text of Ignatov (2023) could contain related invariants.
title: The first nonpure maximal-independent-set shattering complex in the Boolean-cube sequence
